import numpy as np

def process_sheet(x, y):
    # Baseline calculation
    mask_b1 = (x >= 1090) & (x <= 1110)
    mask_b2 = (x >= 1790) & (x <= 1810)
    
    if not np.any(mask_b1) or not np.any(mask_b2):
        return y
        
    b1_val = np.mean(y[mask_b1])
    b2_val = np.mean(y[mask_b2])
    b1_x = np.mean(x[mask_b1])
    b2_x = np.mean(x[mask_b2])
    
    # Linear baseline for all x points
    baseline = np.interp(x, [b1_x, b2_x], [b1_val, b2_val])
    
    # Subtract baseline
    y_corrected = y - baseline
    
    # Normalize by G-band max in 1550-1620 range
    mask_g = (x >= 1550) & (x <= 1620)
    if np.any(mask_g):
        g_max = np.max(y_corrected[mask_g])
        if g_max > 0:
            y_norm = y_corrected / g_max
        else:
            y_norm = y_corrected
    else:
        y_norm = y_corrected
        
    return y_norm
